en.headline: Federated Hermes opens Hong Kong office in Central
en.dek: The US asset manager, which manages US$884 billion, has set up in the Nexxus Building after two years of preparation to deepen Asia-Pacific ties.
body: US asset manager Federated Hermes has opened an office in Hong Kong’s Central district, joining other international firms expanding in the city’s wealth and asset-management market.

The company, which managed US$884 billion in assets as of September, began considering a Hong Kong presence two years ago. Its board later approved the plan. The new office in the Nexxus Building adds to existing Asia-Pacific locations in Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney.

Jim Roland, head of business development in Asia-Pacific and Australia, said on Wednesday that Hong Kong is a premier wealth and asset-management hub. Opening the office helps deepen relationships with private banks, family offices, wealth intermediaries and institutional investors, and forms part of the firm’s long-term regional growth strategy.
The firm has maintained a presence in the region since 2010 and has focused this year on licensing and registration requirements.

zh.headline: Federated Hermes在中環開設香港辦公室
zh.dek: 這家管理8840億美元資產的美國資產管理公司經過兩年籌備後，在Nexxus大廈設立辦事處，加強亞太聯繫。
body: 美國資產管理公司Federated Hermes在香港中環開設辦公室，加入其他國際機構在本港財富及資產管理市場擴張的行列。
該公司截至9月管理資產達8840億美元，兩年前已考慮在港設立據點，其後董事會批准計劃。新辦公室設於Nexxus大廈，加上新加坡、東京及悉尼的現有據點，擴展亞太足跡。
亞太及澳洲業務發展主管Jim Roland周三表示，香港是首要的財富及資產管理樞紐。開設辦公室有助深化與私人銀行、家族辦公室、財富中介及機構投資者的關係，是公司長遠地區增長策略的一部分。
公司自2010年起在區內保持存在，今年重點處理牌照及註冊要求。
